notes:
Orbit 0.2.1

More messages are read automatically: airtime and data bundles bought on MTN,
money received on M-PESA, and Fuliza advances and repayments.

Two fixes where messages were quietly losing data. A sender's name no longer
swallows the masked phone number it arrived with, and a Fuliza repayment is no
longer mistaken for a limit notice and dropped.
